AbsoluteFileAndFolder.name: AbsoluteFileAndFolder
AbsoluteFileAndFolder.author: Chai Chaimee
AbsoluteFileAndFolder.description: Absolute File and Folder boosts NVDA productivity by streamlining file and directory access via Windows Explorer integration. It lets users capture paths, organize bookmarks, filter files by extension, search history with audio cues, run scripts as admin, and restore active folders after a reboot. Hot Keys: Windows+Backspace Single Tap open AbsoluteFloder Double Tap open AbsoluteFile

AbsoluteSite.name: AbsoluteSite
AbsoluteSite.author: Chai Chaimee
AbsoluteSite.description: Manage bookmarks, capture URLs instantly, track history, and perform quick web searches directly from NVDA. This fully accessible tool organizes your favorite websites into custom categories, assigns preferred browsers, and maximizes windows automatically for seamless browsing efficiency. Hot Keys: ALT+Backspace Single Tap : open Absolute Site Manager Double Tap : add New Site Triple Tap : All More Visited ALT+Windows+Backspace : Search Dialog

AbsoluteTranslate.name: AbsoluteTranslate
AbsoluteTranslate.author: Chai Chaimee
AbsoluteTranslate.description: Absolute Translate is an advanced translation add-on designed for NVDA screen reader users. It provides fast and accurate translation using Google Translate and Google AI Studio Gemini engines. Key features include instant translation of selected text, speech history capture, continuous multi-chunk translation for long documents, auto-language swapping, custom translation styles like formal, friendly, literary, and copywriter, and direct clipboard integration. It enhances accessibility and productivity by delivering reliable translations with caching and full configuration support. Hot Keys: ALT+Windows+T Single : Double : Triple : quadruple : Swap Engine

Access8Math.name: Access8Math
Access8Math.author: Woody Tseng
Access8Math.description: Allows access math content written by MathML ; Allows write math content by LaTeX

AiSound5.name: AiSound5 Chinese TTS Add-On For NVDA
AiSound5.author: NVDA Contributors
AiSound5.description: This is an NVDA speech synthesizer that supports Chinese and requires no other dependencies.

AudioToggles.name: AudioToggles
AudioToggles.author: rajath tirumangalam
AudioToggles.description: Provides keyboard shortcuts to toggle system speaker mute and microphone mute using NVDA.

AutoMaximize.name: Automatically maximize application windows
AutoMaximize.author: tecwindow
AutoMaximize.description: Automatically maximizes application windows to keep controls and interface elements visible and accessible. Especially useful for web-based applications and for creating clear video tutorials and screen recordings.

Autoclip.name: Autoclip, automatically speak clipboard content when it changes
Autoclip.author: Mazen
Autoclip.description: Automatically read the contents of the clipboard when a change is detected. Press NVDA + Shift + Control + K to toggle.

BOA.name: BOA: Better Office Accessibility
BOA.author: MisterK
BOA.description: BOA is a powerful suite of accessibility enhancements for Microsoft Office, outcome of AI assisted development; designed to vastly improve the screen reader experience for NVDA users. The Entire code base has been generated using Anti Gravity 2.0. It directly patches inaccessible UI components and introduces rapid navigation tools for Excel and PowerPoint. Key Features: - Cell Monitor: Save and continuously track dynamic Excel cells. - Sheet Layout Analyzer: Instantly scan worksheets for hidden tabs, protected states, and data blocks. - Bulk Sheet Organizer & Quick Mover: Instantly move or reorder multiple sheets using accessible dialogs. - PowerPoint Color Pickers: Read hidden Hex and RGB codes inside standard color grids. Please refer to the add-on help documentation for a complete list of features and shortcuts.

Banking4W.name: Banking4W - Topbanking
Banking4W.author: Rainer Brell
Banking4W.description: Improves navigation in the portfolio and turnover table.

BrailleExtender.name: Braille Extender
BrailleExtender.author: AAClause
BrailleExtender.description: Braille Extender is an NVDA add-on that extends braille output, braille input, scrolling, and display-specific gestures. It requires NVDA 2024.1 or later. For full documentation, open the User guide from the NVDA menu under Braille Extender. Main features include: * Reload two favorite braille displays with shortcuts * Terminals: braille can follow the review cursor while you edit (PuTTY, PowerShell, cmd, bash, and similar) * Auto scroll with timing and blank-line options * Multiple input and output braille tables, with automatic table selection on NVDA 2025.1 and later * Dots 7 and 8, tags, and spacing or line padding for structure and attributes * Optional second Liblouis pass after the main output table * Display tab characters as spaces; swap forward and back scroll buttons * Speak the current line while scrolling (coordinate with NVDA braille speech settings) * Convert text to Unicode braille and back, and between Unicode braille and dot-number descriptions * Lock the braille keyboard; lock modifier keys from the braille display * Quick launches to applications or web addresses; table dictionaries * One-handed braille input; rules for undefined characters including emoji; advanced input mode and abbreviations * Speech History Mode; configurable rotor; object and document presentation options for braille; role labels; routing in edit fields; margins; updates; and other settings Where a display profile exists, the add-on can add extended gesture maps (function keys, multimedia keys, rotor actions, emulated modifiers, and more). Assign commands in NVDA Input gestures for Braille Extender, or open Gestures for this display from the Braille Extender submenu.

BrowsersDictionary.name: BrowserDictionary
BrowsersDictionary.author: Chai Chaimee
BrowsersDictionary.description: Customize NVDA speech per website with Browsers Dictionary. Features live URL tracking, text and regex replacements by page or domain, JSON file import, and regex safety protections. Automatically substitutes spoken text in real time to deliver accurate, seamless web reading. Hot Key: ALT+Windows+B Single Tap : Open Browsers Dictionary settings Double Tap : Add new site Triple Tab : edit Site

CJKEnhancedUI.name: CJK Enhanced User Interface
CJKEnhancedUI.author: Michael M Chen; Victor Cai; Woody Tseng
CJKEnhancedUI.description: Modifications and enhancements to speech and Braille output intended for CJK locales.

CMDReader.name: CMDReader
CMDReader.author: Chai Chaimee
CMDReader.description: Automatically reads new output in Command Prompt, PowerShell, and Windows Terminal in real-time. Features instant audio notifications for terminal states and errors, customizable error keywords, a dedicated NVDA settings panel for privacy management, and live session shadow history scrolling without disrupting your workflow. Hot Keys: CTRLALT+L : Open CMDReader File ctrl+alt+up arrow : Read the previous line ctrl+alt+down arrow : Read the next line

CaptionLocal.name: caption image useing local AI models
CaptionLocal.author: Tianze
CaptionLocal.description: generate caption for image using local AI models, Describe the image objects browsed by NVDA, support shortcut key recognition.

ClipHistory.name: ClipboardHistory
ClipHistory.author: Chai Chaimee
ClipHistory.description: ClipHistory tracks clipboard activity, automatically saving text and HTML entries to persistent storage. Features include an accessible history dialog, pinning, custom item names, editing, reordering, item deletion, and pasting support for NVDA. Hot Keys: Windows+V Single : open ClipHistory Dialog Double : Clear All ClipBoardHistory

CustomAppModulesMapper.name: Custom App Modules Mapper
CustomAppModulesMapper.author: Marlon Brandão de Sousa
CustomAppModulesMapper.description: Lets you dynamically map any application to any existing NVDA app module, straight from the NVDA settings dialog, without writing an add-on or waiting for a mapping to be merged into NVDA.

CustomLabels.name: Custom Labels
CustomLabels.author: Kefas Lungu
CustomLabels.description: An addon that allows you to add custom labels for unlabeled controls and edit existing ones.

DBeaver-eclipse-nvda.name: DBeaver Eclipse NVDA
DBeaver-eclipse-nvda.author: Jean Braz
DBeaver-eclipse-nvda.description: Enhance the speech and braille support while using the Eclipse IDE and DBeaver reportings errors and warnings.

DictionaryDisplayLite.name: DictionaryDisplayLite
DictionaryDisplayLite.author: Chai Chaimee
DictionaryDisplayLite.description: DictionaryDisplayLite makes managing NVDA speech dictionaries faster and quieter. It condenses list announcements, adds a quick menu, and provides a custom voice dictionary editor with search, validation, and reordering. Hot Keys: Control+Shift+D Single Tap : Open the Voice dictionary dialog Double Tap : Open the Default dictionary dialog Triple Tap (or more) : Open the Temporary dictionary dialog Shift+Windows+D Single Tap : Open the DictionaryDisplayLite quick menu Double Tap : Open Search and Edit Voice Dictionary directly

DoctorNVDA.name: DoctorNVDA
DoctorNVDA.author: Chai Chaimee
DoctorNVDA.description: DoctorNVDA is a diagnostic and recovery utility for NVDA. It recovers frozen speech, analyzes crash logs, isolates faulty add-ons, backs up and restores settings, exports system info, and cleans temporary cache files to maintain screen reader stability. Hot Keys: ALT+Windows+D Single Tap : open DoctorNVDA menu Double Tap : Restart NVDA Tripple Tap : Restart NVDA with add-ons disabled ALT+Windows+R Single : Emergency Synthesizer Reboot, force-reinitialize the speech synthesizer and audio output Double : Crash Log Analyzer collapsed

DragHelper.name: DragHelper
DragHelper.author: LUCA
DragHelper.description: Provides keyboard-accessible drag and drop by allowing users to select a source object, a target object, and the drop position. Especially useful for arranging icons on the Windows desktop and in File Explorer.

EnhancedClipboardReading.name: Enhanced Clipboard Reading
EnhancedClipboardReading.author: Nikola Jović
EnhancedClipboardReading.description: Enhances the default NVDA+C command to read the clipboard with a configurable character limit instead of the hardcoded value of no more than 1023. If there is more text on the clipboard than the configured limit, presents the clipboard text in a browseable message for easier reviewing, instead of saying that the clipboard contains a large portion of text. A browseable message can also be opened at any time by pressing NVDA+C three times quickly, even if there is less text on the clipboard than the configured limit. Pressing NVDA+Y will announce the number of characters on the clipboard, which will also be shown in the title of the browseable messages.

EnhancedDictionaries.name: Enhanced dictionaries processing for NVDA
EnhancedDictionaries.author: Marlon Brandão de Sousa
EnhancedDictionaries.description: This addon introduces better dictionaries handling for NVDA. It is now possible to use profile specific dictionaries, which eenables better productivity by allowing you to use different dictionaries for different applications and scenarius.

EnhancedFindDialog.name: Enhanced find dialog for NVDA
EnhancedFindDialog.author: Marlon Sousa, Thiago Seus
EnhancedFindDialog.description: This addon introduces improvements to the NVDA find dialog. It is now possible to have your previous searches history available on a list during the NVDA session, which will enable you to quickly select and search for previous searched terms.

Hear2ReadNG.name: Hear2Read Indic Speech Synthesizer
Hear2ReadNG.author: Hear2Read
Hear2ReadNG.description: This is a speech synthesizer for 11 Indic languages and English (with Indian accent) that generates natural human speech. It is based on the work done by the piper TTS team (https://github.com/rhasspy/piper). The addon includes a voice manager for installing one or more Indic voices. Supported languages: Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Nepali, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu

IndentNav.name: IndentNav
IndentNav.author: mltony
IndentNav.description: Indentation Navigation addon. It allows NVDA users to navigate by indentation level or offset of lines or paragraphs. Also while editing source code in many programming languages, it allows to jump between the lines of the same indentation level, as well as quickly find lines with greater or lesser indentation level.

IntelliJImproved.name: IntelliJ Improved
IntelliJImproved.author: Samuel Kacer
IntelliJImproved.description: Adds support for using IntelliJ with NVDA.

LIMA.name: LIMA AI
LIMA.author: Roscommon Systems
LIMA.description: LIMA AI is the NVDA add-on companion to the LIMA (Low-Vision Intelligent Machine Assistant) desktop app. It describes what is on screen on demand: press a shortcut and NVDA speaks a brief AI description of the active monitor.

LION.name: LION
LION.author: anmi2004
LION.description: does live OCR for the whole screen, refreshing at a specified interval. Toggle with NVDA+alt+n.

MSEdgeDiscardAnnouncements.name: Microsoft Edge discard announcements
MSEdgeDiscardAnnouncements.author: addonFactory
MSEdgeDiscardAnnouncements.description: Discards UIA announcements in Microsoft Edge such as page loading and refreshing, opening and closing tabs and windows and more.

MathCAT.name: MathCAT: speech and braille from MathML
MathCAT.author: Neil Soiffer
MathCAT.description: MathCAT is a replacement for MathPlayer which has been discontinued. It provides speech and braille support, and also supports MathPlayer's three modes of navigation. The supported languages are: Chinese (Traditional), English, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Norwegian, Polish, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, and Vietnamese. The supported braille codes are: Nemeth, UEB Technical, CMU (Spanish/Portuguese), Russian, Swedish, and Vietnamese braille code standards. Also supported are the German/Austrian braille code standards for ASCIIMath and LaTeX math markup. Other language and braille code translations are in progress.

Mozilla.name: Mozilla Apps Enhancements
Mozilla.author: Javi Dominguez
Mozilla.description: Provides accessibility features for Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird.

NVDACNMirror.name: NVDA Chinese Community Update Mirror
NVDACNMirror.author: zh-yx, Cary-rowen, hwf1324 <support@nvdacn.com>
NVDACNMirror.description: This update mirror source is provided for NVDA Chinese community users. It can enhance the update speed of NVDA, improve the search and download speed of the add-on store, and resolve issues where certain network operators are unable to download add-ons from the add-on store, thus effectively improving user experience.

NVDAInflectMicroTTS.name: NVDAInflect Micro TTS
NVDAInflectMicroTTS.author: Anuj Sharma
NVDAInflectMicroTTS.description: A high-quality local neural text-to-speech voice for NVDA based on the Inflect Micro v2 model created by Owen Song. The model, the ONNX Runtime and all other dependencies are bundled with the add-on, so the voice works fully offline. Speaks English with a fixed male voice at 24 kHz and offers rate, rate boost, volume, variation and seed settings, plus optional GPU acceleration via DirectML (Auto/CPU/GPU compute device choice). i use ai agent in this addon development

NVDAKittenTTS.name: NVDAKitten TTS neural speech synthesizer
NVDAKittenTTS.author: Anuj sharma
NVDAKittenTTS.description: Offline neural speech synthesis for NVDA using Kitten TTS. Ultra-lightweight ONNX model (about 25 MB) bundled with the add-on, all dependencies included (onnxruntime-directml for CPU and GPU). 8 built-in voices (4 female, 4 male). Additional higher-quality models can be downloaded from the Kitten TTS settings panel, which also lets you choose the compute device (CPU or GPU) used for speech. AI Agent use in developmet of this addon

NVDARecorder.name: NVDA recorder
NVDARecorder.author: Rui Fontes
NVDARecorder.description: Record in a text document all the speechs of NVDA, except in SayAll, and shows it in a dialog. Turn on/off with Alt+NumPad Plus.

NeovimAccessLink.name: Neovim Access Link
NeovimAccessLink.author: Emanuel Helms
NeovimAccessLink.description: Accessible Neovim integration for NVDA with structured speech, sound, and Braille feedback for editing, navigation, and spelling suggestions. Supports separate local Windows and remote SSH sessions across Windows Terminal windows, tabs, and panes.

NotepadPlusPlus.name: Notepad++
NotepadPlusPlus.author: Derek Riemer <driemer.riemer@gmail.com>, Tuukka Ojala <tuukka.ojala@gmail.com>
NotepadPlusPlus.description: Notepad++ App Module. This addon improves the accessibility of Notepad ++. To learn more, press the add-on help button.

PPAWakeUp.name: PPA Tatip WakeUp ตาทิพย์จงตื่น!
PPAWakeUp.author: Chai Chaimee
PPAWakeUp.description: PPAWakeUp ensures PPA Tatip runs smoothly with NVDA by automatically recovering from crashes and offering quick engine management. It features auto-reboot upon failure, CJK character speech filtering to prevent freezes, dialog button crash protection, and built-in dictionary backup. Hot Keys: Windows+P Single Tap wake up PPA Tatip Double Tap Open PPA Tatip options Tripple Tap Open Tatip Menu

QQEnhancement.name: PC QQ Enhancement
QQEnhancement.author: Cary-rowen, NVDA Chinese Community and other contributors, Original work by SmileSky<mzdk100@foxmail.com>
QQEnhancement.description: Enhance the experience of using PC QQ for NVDA users.

REGEXPlusPlus.name: REGEX++
REGEXPlusPlus.author: Chai Chaimee
REGEXPlusPlus.description: Provides an intelligent, on-the-fly regex search, preview, and replace dialog that works in virtually any text editor – even those that have no built-in regular expression support. Hot Keys: ALT+Windows+F : Find and Replace REGEX Tools Dialog

SentenceNav.name: SentenceNav
SentenceNav.author: Tony Malykh
SentenceNav.description: Sentence Navigation addon. SentenceNav is an NVDA add-on that allows you to read text by sentences, as opposed to by paragraphs or words.

ShortcutLaunch.name: ShortcutLaunch
ShortcutLaunch.author: Vatsal Gautam
ShortcutLaunch.description: allows you to quickly launch any program, folder, URL or quickly execute a command from command prompt

SiteMarker.name: SiteMarker
SiteMarker.author: Chai Chaimee
SiteMarker.description: SiteMarker streamlines web navigation for NVDA users by bookmarking specific webpage elements for instant access. Key features include site and marker managers, customizable search scopes, and automatic element clicking for hard to reach buttons, saving time on complex pages. Hot Keys: Windows+F12 Single Tap : Add or Edit Marker Double Tap : open Site Manager Triple Tap : open Marker Manager

StudioRecorder.name: Studio Recorder
StudioRecorder.author: Marco Steinebach
StudioRecorder.description: Adds braille support to Studio Recorder produced by APH. Also a few additional keystrokes are implemented to ease common tasks which do not have shortcuts.

TeleNVDA.name: Tele NVDA remote assistance
TeleNVDA.author: jmdaweb
TeleNVDA.description: Allows remote control of and remote access to another machine. This add-on is based on NVDA Remote.

TemporarySkip.name: TemporarySkip
TemporarySkip.author: Yukio Nozawa
TemporarySkip.description: This add-on allows you to register phrases that you want to ignore temporarily. The phrases are not spoken until you cancel it. This add-on extends NVDA's built-in start / end marker feature. Start selecting text with NVDA+F9, move the review cursor to determine the selection and press NVDA+F11 (instead of F10!) to ignore the selected phrase. Selecting the previously ignored text and pressing the same command will make NVDA read it again. Press NVDA+Shift+F11 to clear all of the ignored text and revert everything to default.

TextMarksTheSpot.name: Text Marks the Spot
TextMarksTheSpot.author: Casey Mathews
TextMarksTheSpot.description: Get to the actual content on a web page without working so hard to find it. Hands off. Let the page load, listen for the short beeps, and you're at the start of the article. NVDA reads the first paragraph. Press Z to skim forward, Shift+Z to jump back to the start, NVDA+Z to turn the add-on off on a specific site. Runs locally, no network calls.

TimerForNVDA.name: Simple Timer and stopwatch for NVDA
TimerForNVDA.author: Marlon Brandão de Sousa
TimerForNVDA.description: This addon brings a fast, functional ande simple implementation of timer and stopwatch to be used with NVDA. Start a timer or stopwatch, using the time unit and reporting modes you need. Choose between speech, sound or no reporters. Monitor progress through reporters, settings dialog or anywhere using NVDA commands. Control timer and stopwatch from anywhere using NVDA commands.

TransIPA.name: Reporting the International Phonetic Alphabet in Braille
TransIPA.author: Cary-rowen <manchen_0528@outlook.com>
TransIPA.description: This add-on allows NVDA to report the International Phonetic Alphabet using braille dots. Switch gesture NVDA+Shift+P.

Unspoken-ng.name: Unspoken-ng 3D Audio
Unspoken-ng.author: fastfinge
Unspoken-ng.description: Adds 3D audio for controls and replaces control messages. This updated version uses OpenAL Soft and is only compatible with NVDA 2026.1 and later.

VIVOVoiceInput.name: VIVO Voice Input
VIVOVoiceInput.author: haitun
VIVOVoiceInput.description: Uses VIVO's speech recognition capability for voice input.

VLC.name: VLC Media Player
VLC.author: Javi Dominguez
VLC.description: Provides some accessibility features for VLC Media Player, as improve navigation or read status bar

VolumePower.name: VolumePower
VolumePower.author: Chai Chaimee
VolumePower.description: provides quick control over your computer's NVDA volume and power functions Hot Keys: Alt+Windows+S Single Tap : Shutdown computer Double Tap : Restart computer NVDA+Shift+PageUp Increase NVDA volume NVDA+Shift+PageDown Decrease NVDA volume

WeChatEnhancement.name: PC WeChat Enhancement
WeChatEnhancement.author: Cary-Rowen <manchen_0528@outlook.com>
WeChatEnhancement.description: Enhance the experience of using PC WeChat for NVDA users.

WinTeleport.name: WinTeleport
WinTeleport.author: Cary-rowen <manchen_0528@outlook.com>
WinTeleport.description: WinTeleport - Move windows between virtual desktops with keyboard shortcuts.

WordBridge.name: WordBridge
WordBridge.author: Coseeing Community Contributors, Woody Tseng
WordBridge.description: helps users identify and correct homophone-based typos in Chinese.

WorldVoice.name: WorldVoice
WorldVoice.author: Woody Tseng
WorldVoice.description: Multilingual synthesizer add-on: auto-switches voices across eSpeak, OneCore, SAPI5 & RHVoice based on text language.

YoutubePlus.name: YouTubePlus
YoutubePlus.author: NVDA_TH
YoutubePlus.description: YoutubePlus is an add-on for those who enjoy YouTube but find many web features difficult to access, such as reading comments or live chat. We bring these features to you through the NVDA user interface in an accessible, shortcut-driven, and customizable format. Users do not need to deal with API keys or link any personal data to the add-on. Features: • Follow your favorite channels and be certain you'll see every video they post, without being filtered out by YouTube's algorithm. • A full Favorites system for videos, channels, and playlists, plus a Watch List for videos you want to watch later — with categories, sorting, and background updates to keep channel and playlist info current. • Built-in search with saved search history, plus a Quick Search shortcut that searches instantly using selected text or clipboard content. • Browse a channel's videos, shorts, streams, playlists, and podcasts directly, without leaving the accessible interface. • Read comments and follow live chat replays. • Send a video's thumbnail straight to the Be My Eyes app for a live description (Be My Eyes must be installed) • Download videos, audio, or subtitles (with multiple format options) for offline use. • Supports multiple user profiles, with backup and restore built in.

accessibleDiscord.name: Accessible Discord
accessibleDiscord.author: salmanf16
accessibleDiscord.description: Announces voice channel events (join, leave, mute, deafen) and chat messages in Discord using a BetterDiscord companion plugin.

addonStoreLite.name: addon Store Lite
addonStoreLite.author: Chai Chaimee
addonStoreLite.description: Say goodbye to information overload in the Add-on Store

addonsHelp.name: Add-ons documentation
addonsHelp.author: Rui Fontes
addonsHelp.description: This add-on provides a quick way to access documentation for the add-ons you have installed, creating, in the NVDA Help menu, two sub-menus. One, called "Running add-ons documentation", grouping the documentation and a list of commands for running add-ons, and another sub-menu called "Disabled add-ons documentation", listing the disabled add-ons documentation.

addonsTools.name: Tools for managing add-ons
addonsTools.author: Rui Fontes
addonsTools.description: Set of tools to manage add-ons not available on NVDA add-ons store: * Add-on packager: To create a add-on backup file or to send a modified add-on to someone test or use; * Multiple installer: Allows to select add-ons from a folder and install all at once; * Make/restore Backups: Allow to backup and restore some NVDA preferences, such as configurations, profiles and dictionaries; * Add-ons documentation: allow to open the documentation file.

advanced-nvda-remote.name: Advanced NVDA Remote
advanced-nvda-remote.author: ashu-choudhury
advanced-nvda-remote.description: Try peer-to-peer communication much faster than normal NVDA remote. A smart, advanced remote upgrade.

appOn.name: appOn
appOn.author: Chai Chaimee
appOn.description: appOn is a fast, accessible NVDA add-on that lets you instantly launch installed apps and system tools. Features include auto detection, version tracking, categorization, custom sorting, a settings menu, and live refreshing. Hot Key: ALT+Windows+A : open appOn menu Center

appleMusicSuggestLess.name: Apple Music
appleMusicSuggestLess.author: serrebidev
appleMusicSuggestLess.description: Navigate sections with F6 and Shift+F6, open sidebar pages and Settings with Control+1 through Control+6, search with Control+S, use Home and End in track lists, and play the focused track with Enter. Control+Alt+Down suggests less and Control+Alt+Up favorites and Control+Alt+Shift+Up removes favorites.

applicationDictionary.name: Application dictionary
applicationDictionary.author: Rui Fontes
applicationDictionary.description: Allows creation of application-specific dictionaries. Use the command "NVDA+Control+Shift+d" to access the dictionary for the current application.

atl_productivity_suite.name: ATL Productivity Suite
atl_productivity_suite.author: Accessible tech labs India
atl_productivity_suite.description: An enterprise-grade, accessibility-first global plugin engineered by Accessible Tech Labs India. Designed for visually impaired professionals, this Version 2.1 release transforms NVDA into the ultimate high-performance workstation assistant. Featuring 8 highly optimized utilities including a Pomodoro Focus Stopwatch, Advanced Sentinel Security Scanner, Voice-Assisted Alarms, Smart Workspace Launcher, and seamless Google Quick Search. You can press NVDA+Shift+M to instantly access the centralized ATL Master Menu. The ATL Suite delivers unparalleled speed, 100% privacy, security, and digital inclusion directly through your screen reader environment.

atlastiAccessibility.name: Atlas.ti Accessibility Enhancements
atlastiAccessibility.author: Christos Bouronikos
atlastiAccessibility.description: Improves Atlas.ti accessibility for blind and visually impaired users. Recognises ribbon tabs, managers, panels, buttons, columns and query operators, announces them in English or Greek regardless of Atlas.ti's own interface language, adds shortcuts to every major panel, provides detailed reading commands for codes, quotations, documents, rows and the ribbon, and describes charts and diagrams (Network Editor, Word Cloud, Sankey, Treemap) or points to their accessible table/list equivalent.

audioScreen.name: AudioScreen
audioScreen.author: josephsl
audioScreen.description: Allows you to "feel" images with your ears, while moving your finger around a touch screen on Windows 10 and above.

audioSwitcher.name: Audio Switcher
audioSwitcher.author: kamal yaser
audioSwitcher.description: Sets configured or directly selected speakers and microphones as default and announces current defaults.

audioTimer.name: Audio Timer
audioTimer.author: addonWorkshop
audioTimer.description: Plays a sound at regular intervals. Recurrent / oneshot timers, multiple timers with different settings...

audioVolumeControl.name: Per-Application Volume Control
audioVolumeControl.author: JoaoDEVWHADS
audioVolumeControl.description: Control the volume of individual applications using keyboard shortcuts. Press Ctrl+NVDA+Y to open the volume control dialog and adjust volume per application. Supports precise volume control with multiple increment levels and real-time announcements. Tested on NVDA 2025.3.2. Users may modify manifest.ini for other versions. Contact: https://t.me/tierryt2021

autosleepMode.name: Autosleep Mode
autosleepMode.author: Lukáš Hosnedl
autosleepMode.description: Turns NVDA's sleep mode on automatically whenever an application you have listed comes to the foreground.

axygenChecklist.name: Axygen Checklist
axygenChecklist.author: Ruslan Iskov
axygenChecklist.description: Walk a test checklist with global commands while the system focus stays in the application under test. Items are marked passed, failed or skipped, commented and read back by speech, without ever leaving the window being tested. Checklists are plain JSON files that record the result of the run.

batteryChime.name: BatteryChime
batteryChime.author: leo
batteryChime.description: Get audio warnings when your battery is running low, plugged in, unplugged, or fully charged. Choose from 13 built-in sounds or your own WAV file for each event, and set your own warning percentages for low, critical, and emergency battery levels.

blackout.name: Blackout - Darkens the screen except for the speech and Braille viewer
blackout.author: BFW Würzburg
blackout.description: demonstrates the information NVDA users receive, while ensuring that sighted people are not distracted by the rest of the screen. With NVDA+Alt+b the entire screen is completely darkened. - If the Speech Viewer is active, it stays visible. If it is not active, it will be automatically opened. - The Braille Viewer can be manually activated and will then also be displayed.

brailleCellIgnorer.name: Braille Cell Ignorer
brailleCellIgnorer.author: cary-rowen <manchen_0528@outlook.com>
brailleCellIgnorer.description: An NVDA add-on that allows you to ignore damaged or malfunctioning braille display cells.

brailleEssentials.name: Braille Essentials
brailleEssentials.author: josephsl
brailleEssentials.description: This add-on provides essential features for NVDA users relying on braille support. The following features, deriving from Braille Extender, are available: * Reload two favorite braille display with shortcuts. * Automatic review cursor tethering in terminal role like in PuTTY, Powershell, bash, cmd. * Auto scroll. * Switch between several input/output braille tables. * Mark the text with special attributes through dot 7, dot 8 or both. * Use two output braille tables simultaneously. * Display tab signs as spaces. * Reverse forward scroll and back scroll buttons. * Say the current line during text scrolling either in review mode, or in focus mode or both. * Translate text easily in Unicode braille and vice versa. E.g.: z <--> ⠵. * Convert cell description to Unicode braille and vice versa. E.g.: 123 <--> ⠇. * Lock braille keyboard. * Launch an application/URL with gesture. * Braille dictionaries. * Type with one-hand from braille keyboard. * Display undefined characters from braille tables (including emojis) using altenative representations. * Enter any character from braille keyboard (including emojis). * Skip blank lines during text scrolling. * Speech History Mode. And much more. For some braille displays, it extends the braille display commands to provide: * Offer complete gesture maps including function keys, multimedia keys, quick navigation, etc. * Emulate modifier keys, and thus any keyboard shortcut * Offer several keyboard configurations concerning the possibility to input dots 7 and 8, enter and backspace * Add actions and quick navigation through a rotor

browserOptions.name: Browser Options
browserOptions.author: Andhi Mardianto
browserOptions.description: Open URL and Searching with Option Browsers

browsernav.name: BrowserNav
browsernav.author: mltony
browsernav.description: Browser Navigation addon. In browsers it allows to quickly find vertically aligned paragraphs with the same offset from the left edge of the screen, such as first level comments in a hierarchical tree of comments. It can also find paragraphs with the same font size or same font style.

calibre.name: Calibre accessibility enhancements
calibre.author: Javi Dominguez
calibre.description: Provides some accessibility enhancements for the interface of Calibre eBook Management

capitalSelectionIndicator.name: Capital Selection Indicator
capitalSelectionIndicator.author: Cary-rowen <manchen_0528@outlook.com>
capitalSelectionIndicator.description: A prototype NVDA add-on that addresses GitHub issues #18360, #4874 and #12996. This add-on adds capital letter indicators (beep, pitch change, "cap" prefix) when selecting single characters, matching the behavior of character navigation.

charDescMerge.name: Char Desc Merge
charDescMerge.author: addonWorkshop
charDescMerge.description: Adds ability to merge character descriptions from several localizations. For example, you can add a description of the cyrillic characters to english localization.

charInfo.name: Character information
charInfo.author: Cyrille Bougot
charInfo.description: This add-on allows to present in a message various information about a character. It also allows to customize the information reported on a character when using review cursor character navigation commands or multiple presses of the review character command.

chargingNotifier.name: Charging Notifier
chargingNotifier.author: Cary-rowen <manchen_0528@outlook.com>
chargingNotifier.description: An add-on for NVDA that allows you to customize AC power status alerts using voice announcements, sound notifications, or both.

checkGestures.name: Check Input Gestures
checkGestures.author: Oleksandr Gryshchenko
checkGestures.description: Find and fix input gestures conflicts in NVDA and add-ons.

cleanTerminalOutput.name: Clean Terminal Output
cleanTerminalOutput.author: Ripple Software
cleanTerminalOutput.description: Cleans whitespace from text on the clipboard with a single keystroke. Built for text copied out of a terminal with the review cursor, where every line picks up trailing spaces and blank lines fill with spaces: it strips trailing whitespace, turns space-only lines into empty lines, takes lines flush left, and collapses runs of blank lines. Works on any clipboard text, not just terminal output.

clipContentsDesigner.name: Clip Contents Designer
clipContentsDesigner.author: nvdaes
clipContentsDesigner.description: Allows the joining of separate fragments of text on the clipboard and clearing of clipboard content. Current text on the clipboard can be presented in browse mode. Option to request confirmation before performing actions such as copy, cut, add text, or clearing the clipboard to avoid accidental changes.

clipboardEnhancement.name: Clipboard Enhancement
clipboardEnhancement.author: Cary-rowen <manchen_0528@outlook.com>
clipboardEnhancement.description: Clipboard Enhancement is an add-on for the NVDA (NonVisual Desktop Access) screen reader. This add-on is designed to enhance the functionality related to the clipboard and the text last spoken by NVDA. It aims to improve the user experience by providing more control and flexibility over the clipboard content and the text spoken by NVDA.

clock.name: Clock
clock.author: Hrvoje Katic <hrvojekatic@gmail.com>, Abdel <abdelkrim.bensaid@gmail.com>
clock.description: An advanced clock and calendar for NVDA. NVDA+F12, get current time. NVDA+F12 pressed twice quickly, get current date. NVDA+F12 pressed three times quickly, reports the current day, the week number, the current year and the remaining days before the end of the year. For other instructions, press actions button in add-on store, then go to help.

commandHelper.name: Command Helper
commandHelper.author: Javi Dominguez
commandHelper.description: Provides a alternative method for executing scripts for people who have difficulty pressing complicated key combinations.

commandRunner.name: Command runner for NVDA input gesture dialog
commandRunner.author: Çağrı Doğan <cagrid@hotmail.com>
commandRunner.description: Adds "Run" buttons to NVDA's Input Gestures dialog, so you can run the command currently selected in the tree right away, without closing the dialog or having to remember its assigned key combination. Four buttons are provided (Run 1x (alt+1), 2x (alt+2), 3x (alt+3) and 4x (alt+4)), each running the command that many times in a row. This makes it easy to run commands whose behaviour changes depending on how many times in a row they are pressed, such as reporting the time on the first press and the date on the second. Works both with NVDA's own built-in commands and with commands added by other add-ons. While a command runs, the dialog is briefly hidden, with speech muted around the hide/show so NVDA's own focus announcements don't interrupt or get mixed up with whatever the command itself reports.

contentFirstBrowse.name: Browse mode content first
contentFirstBrowse.author: shenguangrong
contentFirstBrowse.description: In browse mode content is read before role and state information.

contrast-checker-nvda.name: Color Contrast Checker for NVDA
contrast-checker-nvda.author: Carter Temm <cartertemm@gmail.com>
contrast-checker-nvda.description: Add-on that presents the color contrast of the system caret, navigator object, and all elements on the page. Primarily useful for helping blind digital accessibility testers determine whether visible text and controls meet thresholds set out by the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).

controlTypeBeforeLabel.name: Say control type before label
controlTypeBeforeLabel.author: Pierre-Louis Renaud
controlTypeBeforeLabel.description: A flexible add-on that allows NVDA to announces the type and state of the GUI controls before their label. The names of types and states can also be customized. The add-on supports checkboxes, radio buttons and checkable menu items. More info on : https://www.rptools.org/access/?p=controltypebeforelabel

controlUsageAssistant.name: Control Usage Assistant
controlUsageAssistant.author: nvdaes
controlUsageAssistant.description: Allows you to find out how to interact with the focused control, useful for new computer users new to Windows and to NVDA.

cursorLocator.name: Cursor Locator
cursorLocator.author: nvdaes
cursorLocator.description: Reports cursor positions while typing on multiline edit controls.

customBrowseMode.name: Custom Browse Mode
customBrowseMode.author: nvdaes
customBrowseMode.description: Activates or deactivates profiles deppending on browse mode state. The browseMode profile can be edited when browse mode is not active, from the NVDA's menu, Configuration profiles dialog.

customNotifications.name: Custom Notifications
customNotifications.author: nvdaes
customNotifications.description: Choose how NVDA should read toast notifications. You can read just the application which sent a toast, and choose if notifications are spoken, displayed in braille or both. This may improve your experience with toast notifications and help you to keep your privacy.

deltaTalk.name: MicroPower DeltaTalk TTS
deltaTalk.author: Patrick Barboza <patrickbarboza774@gmail.com>, Wendrill Aksenow Brandão <wendrillaksenow@gmail.com>
deltaTalk.description: DeltaTalk is the first high-quality speech synthesizer available for the Portuguese language. This add-on implements NVDA compatibility with this synthesizer.

dengjen_neural_voices.name: Dengjen Neural Voices
dengjen_neural_voices.author: Ali Ustek
dengjen_neural_voices.description: Adds fast, local neural text-to-speech voices to NVDA. Provides a synthesizer driver for Piper voice models via the Sonata engine, together with a voice manager for downloading and installing voices.

detailedElementInfo.name: Detailed Element Info
detailedElementInfo.author: Mustafa Elçiçek
detailedElementInfo.description: Shows accessibility, ARIA, and DOM details for the focused HTML element on web pages.

devBox.name: Dev Box
devBox.author: addonWorkshop
devBox.description: Adds useful features for developers (consecutive spaces folding, diff indication and more). Also could be useful for users who work with text.

discordMessageHotkeys.name: Discord Message Hotkeys
discordMessageHotkeys.author: Leos
discordMessageHotkeys.description: Read the last 10 messages in the current Discord channel with Alt+1 (newest) through Alt+0 (10th newest). Press the same key twice quickly to reply to that message. Alt+D moves focus to the first unread message (the 'New messages' marker). Alt+Shift+N cycles auto-reading of incoming messages in the open channel (off, polite, interrupt); the default is also set in NVDA Settings. NVDA+Ctrl+Shift+F10 saves a structure dump to the Downloads folder for debugging. Outside a channel the hotkeys warn quickly instead of hanging. The message-list search is bounded, time-limited, and cached so it cannot freeze NVDA.

documentFormattingRotor.name: Document Formatting Rotor
documentFormattingRotor.author: Derek Riemer <driemer.riemer@gmail.com>
documentFormattingRotor.description: Provides a simple rotor that can be used to cycle through document formatting settings. Press nvda/g to envoke.

documentReaderForNvda.name: Document reader for NVDA
documentReaderForNvda.author: Sujan Rai
documentReaderForNvda.description: A powerful NVDA add-on for accessible document reading with advanced features. Developed by Sujan Rai, this add-on allows you to read your document files directly within the NVDA screen reader. Often, we need to read document files, but uploading them to external servers can compromise your privacy. This add-on ensures that your documents are processed entirely locally, keeping your documents safe. Beyond simple document reading, this add-on provides a wealth of features for manipulation, accessibility, OCR, read-aloud capabilities, and much more. Supported documents: PDF, docx, epub. This add-on is the next generation add-on for the previous and outdated PDF reader add-on. For feedback and support, email: blindtechvisionary@gmail.com Join our official Telegram channel for more resources: https://t.me/blindtechvisionary Made and maintained in: Nepal. Thank you for using this add-on!

dotPad.name: Dot Pad
dotPad.author: Dot Incorporated
dotPad.description: Output braille text and graphics to Dot Pad braille displays.

dropbox.name: Dropbox
dropbox.author: Rui Fontes
dropbox.description: Announces Dropbox status or open the Dropbox systray menu. Shortcut: NVDA+Alt+D

eMule.name: eMule
eMule.author: nvdaes
eMule.description: Improves eMule's accessibility with NVDA. eMule is a P2P program to search and share files. You can get more information about eMule at http://www.emule-project.net

easyNavigation.name: easyNavigation
easyNavigation.author: Javi Dominguez
easyNavigation.description: Substitute single key commands for arrow keys to scroll through headings, links, etc. so that you can do everything with one hand.

easyTableCopy.name: Easy Table Copy
easyTableCopy.author: Çağrı Doğan <cagrid@hotmail.com>
easyTableCopy.description: EasyTableCopy lets you copy tables, lists, and grids from the Web, desktop apps, and Windows Explorer into Word, Excel, or Outlook — with formatting intact. Mark specific rows or columns to copy, grab a single cell, flatten a tree view, or copy an entire folder listing, all with a keystroke.

easyTableNavigator.name: Easy Table Navigator
easyTableNavigator.author: Corentin Bacqué-Cazenave
easyTableNavigator.description: Allows using just arrow keys to navigate between table cells via a dedicated layer.

edico.name: EDICO Scientific Editor
edico.author: Alberto Zanella
edico.description: This addon provides access to the EDICO scientific editor

emoticons.name: Emoticons
emoticons.author: nvdaes
emoticons.description: Enables the announcement of emoticon names instead of the character Representation.

enDashBash.name: En Dash Bash
enDashBash.author: Bill Dengler
enDashBash.description: En Dash Bash adds input gestures (NVDA commands) to enter the en dash (–) and em dash (—) quickly. En dashes are used to connect symmetric items, such as the two ends of a range of numbers or dates; to contrast values or illustrate a relationship between two things (such as Mexican–American War); to compound attributes, where one of the connected items is itself a compound (such as New York–style pizza); and, when spaced, to set off parenthetical expressions – like this one – in the middle of sentences. In some languages, en dashes are sometimes used to indicate a change of speaker in quoted dialogue. Unspaced em dashes are used similarly to spaced en dashes to set off parenthetical expressions. By default, NVDA+- types an en dash, and NVDA+Shift+- types an em dash. These commands can be changed in NVDA's input gestures dialog.

enhancedAnnotations.name: Enhanced Annotations
enhancedAnnotations.author: nvdaes
enhancedAnnotations.description: Adds ability to move the cursor to additional details, and back to the original element, in browse mode. This has been requested at https://github.com/nvaccess/nvda/issues/13940

enhancedControlSupport.name: Enhanced Control Support
enhancedControlSupport.author: Emil-18
enhancedControlSupport.description: Adds support for more controls in NVDA.

enhancedDuck.name: Enhanced Duck
enhancedDuck.author: Prateek Kumar
enhancedDuck.description: Extends NVDA audio ducking with focus-aware modes for ducking active or inactive application windows.

enhancedLanguageDetection.name: Enhanced Language Detection
enhancedLanguageDetection.author: Emil-18
enhancedLanguageDetection.description: Automaticly detects the language of the text NVDA is about to speak, and uses NVDA's built in auto language switching, if turned on, to sspeak the text in that language

enhancedObjectNavigation.name: Enhanced Object Navigation
enhancedObjectNavigation.author: Emil-18
enhancedObjectNavigation.description: Allows you to use single letter navigation everyware, and to search for objects by name

enhancedTouchGestures.name: Enhanced Touch Gestures
enhancedTouchGestures.author: josephsl
enhancedTouchGestures.description: This add-on provides additional touchscreen gestures for NVDA, including focus reporting and synth settings ring gestures.

enhanced_symbol_cycler.name: Enhanced Symbol Cycler
enhanced_symbol_cycler.author: JasperLee
enhanced_symbol_cycler.description: Allows you to choose which punctuation/symbol levels (none, some, most, all) are available when pressing NVDA+p to cycle between symbol levels.

evtTracker.name: Event Tracker
evtTracker.author: josephsl
evtTracker.description: Tracks events and displays information about them (for developers and power users)

fastRead.name: FastRead
fastRead.author: Andre Louis
fastRead.description: Speaks changing screen text immediately, interrupting older FastRead speech.

favoriteFolders.name: Favorite folders and files - Register favorite folders and files
favoriteFolders.author: Rui Fontes
favoriteFolders.description: Register favorite folders and files to provide quick access to them. Shortcuts: WINDOWS+BACKSPACE: Open favorite folders dialog.. SHIFT+WINDOWS+BACKSPACE: Open favorite files dialog.

favoriteLinks.name: Favorite links
favoriteLinks.author: Edilberto Fonseca
favoriteLinks.description: This add-on allows you to save, edit and remove links to frequently visited pages. Shortcut Windows+Alt+K.

filezilla.name: FileZilla
filezilla.author: Nael Sayegh
filezilla.description: This module improves the FileZilla software by adding shortcuts and labels to unnamed buttons.

greekMathReader.name: Greek Math Reader
greekMathReader.author: Bouronikos Christos
greekMathReader.description: Reads MathML, LaTeX, and UnicodeMath aloud in natural Greek, following the dictation conventions used in Greek schools and universities. Uses conservative semantic interpretation, terminology profiles, statistics, vector calculus, quantum notation, SI units, fractions, powers, integrals, derivatives, and matrices. Includes interactive navigation to explore complex expressions part by part, three verbosity levels, configurable pronunciations and matrix reading, unsaved speech previews, and voice download options for OneCore and Vocalizer Expressive.

invisinote.name: invisinote
invisinote.author: ClippyCat
invisinote.description: Invisinote is an NVDA add-on for reading plain-text notes without leaving the application you are working in. No window opens and focus never moves: the notes are loaded into memory and you browse them entirely with keyboard gestures, while the app you are in keeps the focus. Folders and notes: - NVDA+ALT+P: open the current folder in File Explorer - NVDA+ALT+[: previous folder - NVDA+ALT+]: next folder - NVDA+ALT+N: load the notes in the current folder - NVDA+ALT+U: previous note - NVDA+ALT+O: next note Reading: - NVDA+ALT+SHIFT+A: read the whole note - NVDA+ALT+I: previous line - NVDA+ALT+K: next line - NVDA+ALT+J: previous word - NVDA+ALT+L: next word - NVDA+ALT+,: previous character - NVDA+ALT+.: next character - NVDA+ALT+H: start of line - NVDA+ALT+': end of line - NVDA+ALT+Space: render the note as Markdown and read it in a browse-mode window Copying: - NVDA+ALT+A: copy the whole note - NVDA+ALT+;: copy the current line - NVDA+ALT+F9: set the selection start at the current position - NVDA+ALT+F10: set the selection end; press twice to copy the selection - NVDA+ALT+BACKSPACE: clear the selection markers Encoding: - NVDA+ALT+E: switch to the next note encoding - NVDA+ALT+SHIFT+E: switch to the previous note encoding Settings live in NVDA's Settings dialog (NVDA+CTRL+S) under the Invisinote category. An Open Invisinote settings command that jumps straight to that category is available in NVDA's Input Gestures dialog, under the invisinote category, if you would like to assign a shortcut of your own.

lastItemAnnouncer.name: Last Item Announcer
lastItemAnnouncer.author: Jan Balák
lastItemAnnouncer.description: Announces the last item in HTML lists (ul/ol/dl). Provides configurable position info; item-number counting and nesting-level announcements. Full support for definition lists (a.k.a. description lists): I/Shift+I pair navigation; term/definition labels; item-count correction. Works in browse mode (web) and in applications.

mainLandmarkNavigator.name: Main Landmark Navigator
mainLandmarkNavigator.author: Jan Balák
mainLandmarkNavigator.description: Adds quick navigation commands (J / Shift+J) to move between main landmarks (<main> and role="main") on web pages. Commands only activate in browse mode; in all other contexts the keys are forwarded unchanged. Fully reconfigurable via NVDA's Input Gestures dialog.

markdownNavigator.name: Markdown Navigator
markdownNavigator.author: cary-rowen <manchen_0528@outlook.com>
markdownNavigator.description: An NVDA add-on that provides structured navigation (headings, lists, tables, etc.) in editable text areas for Markdown files.

mathSonifier.name: Math Sonifier - Audio Graphing for Equations & Data
mathSonifier.author: Anmol Narula
mathSonifier.description: Converts mathematical functions f(x), LaTeX equations, formulas, and data series into intuitive stereo audio graphs. Features interactive keyboard audio trace, audible landmark cues (roots, extrema), presets, and customizable sound synthesis for blind and visually impaired users.

messengerAccess.name: messengerAccess
messengerAccess.author: NVDA_TH
messengerAccess.description: If you find reading chat messages in Facebook Messenger too difficult, this add-on might be able to help you. Warning: User usage requires knowledge of userScript installation. For this add-on, we will use userScript installed on the browser to edit the display of chat messages and forward it to the add-on. You can use shortcut keys to read the message. Users can focus in the text field and press the control+[/] keyboard shortcut to keep the conversation flowing. No need to move focus around often.

mouseEnhancement.name: Mouse Enhancement
mouseEnhancement.author: hwf1324
mouseEnhancement.description: This add-on provides enhancement to mouse functionality in NVDA. For example: Fixed mouse tracking in Electron app (Only 2024.4 or later). Electron apps, such as VS Code. Experimental fix for mouse tracking in WinUI apps. WinUI applications: e.g. Windows Terminal, PowerToys v0.86.0 and higher, some applications that come with Windows, etc. Automatically update the mouse object.

navSounds.name: Navigation Sound Effects
navSounds.author: Ahmed Samy
navSounds.description: NVDA add-on providing navigation and typing sound effects with customizable sound packs, browse mode support, and mouse hover feedback.

notepadMarkdownBrowseMode.name: Notepad Markdown Browse Mode
notepadMarkdownBrowseMode.author: abdel792
notepadMarkdownBrowseMode.description: An NVDA screen reader add-on providing virtual buffer support and quick navigation for Markdown documents in Microsoft Notepad (IAccessible and UIA). Features: Quick navigation: H / Shift+H: Headings (levels 1 to 6) K / Shift+K: Links Q / Shift+Q: Block quotes L / Shift+L: Lists I / Shift+I: List items Elements List dialog (NVDA+F7) to inspect and jump to structural elements.

numpadNavMode.name: Numpad Nav Mode
numpadNavMode.author: Luke Davis, josephsl
numpadNavMode.description: Allows switching the numpad between NVDA navigation mode, and Windows navigation mode. Especially useful if migrating from Jaws; or for laptop users preferring laptop mode, but who have a numpad and want to use it for arrow keys, etc. The add-on also gives control of numlock state when starting NVDA or changing profiles.

nvdaDevTestToolbox.name: NVDA Dev & Test Toolbox
nvdaDevTestToolbox.author: Cyrille Bougot
nvdaDevTestToolbox.description: NVDA Dev & Test Toolbox provides tools for debugging and testing NVDA. Its log tools make it easier to navigate and analyze logs, inspect errors and tracebacks, save log backups, and anonymize logs before sharing them. Specific function calls and markers can also be logged. It is also possible to open the corresponding source code from a log items, console variables or even typing a command gesture. The add-on also extends the Python console and provides utilities such as reverse translation of NVDA's interface strings and an enhanced restart dialog.

objWatcher.name: obj Watcher
objWatcher.author: Cary-rowen <manchen_0528@outlook.com>, hwf1324 <1398969445@qq.com>
objWatcher.description: This NVDA add-on watches changes to attributes of navigation objects.

openLinkWith.name: Open Link With
openLinkWith.author: Ibrahim Hamadeh
openLinkWith.description: Extract links if found in selected, last spoken or clipboard text, display them in a list in a dialog, giving you the option to open any link with various browsers found on computer. The current context command checks selected text, then last spoken text, then clipboard, and uses the first source containing a valid link. Press the command you assotiated with the addon via input gestures, to display OpenLinkWith dialog.

outlookExtended.name: Outlook Extended
outlookExtended.author: Cyrille Bougot
outlookExtended.description: This add-on improves the use of Microsoft Outlook with NVDA. It provides commands to read, move to, or copy various parts of a message such as message headers, attachments, information bar, notification or message body. It also improves navigation within the application and provides more feedback when performing certain actions.

pageReporter.name: Page Reporter
pageReporter.author: Rosendo Barde Hubilla Jr. and Joseph bautista
pageReporter.description: Announces page load status and element summary after a web page loads in browse mode. Toggle with NVDA+Shift+W. Configure in NVDA Preferences.

pcKbBrl.name: PC Keyboard Braille Input
pcKbBrl.author: nvdaes
pcKbBrl.description: Allows braille to be entered via the PC keyboard.

protonVPNAccessibility.name: ProtonVPN Accessibility
protonVPNAccessibility.author: Mama Sene
protonVPNAccessibility.description: Improves accessibility of the ProtonVPN Windows application for NVDA users. Main features: - Proper labeling of buttons and controls - Dynamic announcements for VPN status information - Announcements for IP address, country, provider and traffic - Keyboard shortcuts for quick actions - French and English documentation This is a community add-on and is not affiliated with Proton AG.

proxy.name: Proxy support
proxy.author: jmdaweb
proxy.description: This add-on allows NVDA connecting to the Internet through a proxy server.

qbrailleXLWinUSB.name: QBraille XL USB and Bluetooth driver
qbrailleXLWinUSB.author: roundface
qbrailleXLWinUSB.description: Connects a HIMS QBraille XL / Braille EDGE compatible display through USB WinUSB or Bluetooth serial (SPP), with automatic detection.

remotePlusPlus.name: Remote++
remotePlusPlus.author: Cary-rowen <cary-rowen@outlook.com>
remotePlusPlus.description: Enhances NVDA Remote with productivity features for power users.

ribbonMenu.name: Ribbon Menu
ribbonMenu.author: Alexandru Vida
ribbonMenu.description: Navigate the Microsoft Office Ribbon as a classic menu, with arrows, Enter and Escape.

robEnhancements.name: ROB enhancements
robEnhancements.author: Rainer Brell
robEnhancements.description: This extension adds new functionality to applications and provides new global help: Windows Explorer: braille now also shows the detail columns (date modified, type, size, ...) for the focused file/folder The NVDA settings allow you to specify whether the language should also read the entire line aloud. the inline rename edit box (F2) now uses a "Rename" label instead of repeating the file/folder name If a Markdown file (*.md) is selected in Windows Explorer or total Commander: NVDA+Alt+Space, Views the file in the NVDA browser. NVDA+Alt+Shift+Space, saves the file in HTML format. In all browsers: NVDA+Ctrl+f4, show page URL, press twice, copy to clipboard. Generally: NVDA+Shift+v, shows program name, 32/64bit, CPU usagee, version, product name Microsoft Outlook 13 or later: Shift+Alt+j, Jumps to the next folder with unread emails below the Inbox folder. Shift+Ctrl+Alt+i, Saves the current folder as Folder 1 Shift+Alt+i, Go to Folder 1 A further 4 folders can be defined and jumped to. The folders can also be in another account. The gestures for this are still freely available.

smartSpeakKeys.name: Smart Speak Keys Filter
smartSpeakKeys.author: Rosendo Barde Hubilla Jr. and Joseph Bautista
smartSpeakKeys.description: Filters which keys are spoken when Speak Command Keys is enabled. Mimics JAWS behavior by suppressing NVDA command keys and customizable keys from being spoken.

soundAlign.name: soundAlign
soundAlign.author: Chai Chaimee
soundAlign.description: This add-on provides flexible customization of NVDA sound direction and patterns, including progress indicators Hot Key: NVDA+Windows+S Single Tap : Open soundAlign setting Double Tap : Toggle On and Off SoundAlign

speakTypingWords.name: Typed Word Speaking Enhancement
speakTypingWords.author: Javi Dominguez
speakTypingWords.description: NVDA reads the entire word when it is modified, instead of just the added part, which is the default behavior.

specialCharacter.name: specialCharacter
specialCharacter.author: Chai Chaimee
specialCharacter.description: Special Character is an NVDA add-on that lets you instantly insert symbols and special characters anywhere. It features two customizable sets of twelve slots, a dedicated settings panel, and context-aware insertion logic for various apps. It also includes smart tap control, dedicated dash shortcuts, and persistent configuration. Hot Keys: Ctrl+0-9, Ctrl+Minus, and Ctrl+Equals : Insert Slot 1-12 Shift+Windows+. : Insert En Dash Shift+Windows+/ : Insert Em Dash Shift+Backspace Single tap: Toggle character set Double tap: Toggle On or Off

speechHistory.name: Speech history review and copying
speechHistory.author: James Scholes
speechHistory.description: This add-on allows you to review the most recent strings spoken by NVDA, by default using Shift+F11 and Shift+F12. Additionally, you can copy any spoken item to the clipboard by pressing F12. Use the settings panel for the add-on to increase or decrease the maximum number of stored history entries, and decide whether whitespace should be trimmed from the start or end of text. Use NVDA's Input Gestures dialog to change the supplied keystrokes.

spssAccessibility.name: SPSS Accessibility Plugin
spssAccessibility.author: Bouronikos Christos
spssAccessibility.description: SPSS Accessibility Plugin improves IBM SPSS Statistics accessibility for blind and visually impaired users. Created by Bouronikos Christos, contact: chrisbouronikos@gmail.com. If this add-on helps you, please consider a kind donation via PayPal: https://paypal.me/christosbouronikos

stationPlaylist.name: StationPlaylist
stationPlaylist.author: josephsl
stationPlaylist.description: Enhances support for StationPlaylist apps. In addition, adds global commands for the Studio application from everywhere.

systrayList.name: SysTrayList
systrayList.author: Rui Batista
systrayList.description: Shows the list of buttons on the System Tray with NVDA+F11 once, twice shows running task lists.

taskSwitcher.name: Task Switcher
taskSwitcher.author: mltony
taskSwitcher.description: Task Switcher add-on for NVDA provides configurable keystrokes to switch between applications.

telegramDesktop.name: Telegram Desktop Accessibility
telegramDesktop.author: Ken Chang
telegramDesktop.description: Improves Telegram Desktop accessibility for NVDA users. Adds Alt+1 to move focus to the chat list, Alt+M to open Telegram's main menu, and Alt+Y, Alt+N, Alt+A and Alt+V to answer a call, hang up, mute the microphone and turn the camera on or off. The add-on uses Telegram's stable UIA class information and leaves Telegram's native accessible names unchanged.

terminalAccess.name: Terminal Access for NVDA
terminalAccess.author: Pratik Patel
terminalAccess.description: Provides enhanced terminal accessibility for Windows Terminal and PowerShell, enabling screen reader users to efficiently navigate and interact with command-line interfaces. Inspired by TDSR (Terminal Data Structure Reader) and incorporates functionality from both TDSR and Speakup. Advanced features inspired by community suggestions and discussions.

tesseractOCR.name: TesseractOCR: An OCR add-on
tesseractOCR.author: Rui Fontes
tesseractOCR.description: Performs OCR on the selected image file, PDF, JPG, TIF, etc, or a document through a scanner and also can get the text from an accessible PDF file. The results are shown in a text file. Windows+Control+r - Performs OCR to the selected image file Windows+Control+w - Scans and recognize the document in the scanner Windows+Control+t - To get the text from an accessible PDF

thunderbirdPlusG5.name: Thunderbird+ G5.1 (TB >= 140)
thunderbirdPlusG5.author: Pierre-Louis Renaud
thunderbirdPlusG5.description: This add-on significantly increases the efficiency and comfort of using Thunderbird with NVDA.

tiflotecniaVoices.name: Tiflotecnia voices for NVDA
tiflotecniaVoices.author: Rui Fontes
tiflotecniaVoices.description: Tiflotecnia voices for NVDA NVDA driver to the Cerence Embedded TTS synth License required to use the voices.

translate.name: Translate
translate.author: Yannick Plassiard, salmanf16
translate.description: An ultra-fast and lightweight online translation addon for NVDA. Originally created by Yannick Plassiard, this modified version has been optimized for rapid real-time translations using high-speed cloud engines. Special thanks and full credit go to the original developer for his exceptional work. Requires an internet connection.

unicodeBrailleInput.name: Unicode Braille Input
unicodeBrailleInput.author: Leonard de Ruijter
unicodeBrailleInput.description: Utilities to convert text to Unicode braille

unmute.name: Unmute Windows audio
unmute.author: Oleksandr Hryshchenko
unmute.description: When NVDA starts, this add-on checks the status of the Windows sound system and, if the sound is turned off, turns it on.

updateChannel.name: Update channel selector
updateChannel.author: jmdaweb
updateChannel.description: This add-on allows you to switch quickly between NVDA snapshots and release types. Go to the update channel category on the NVDA settings dialog, choose your update channel and check for updates from the NVDA help menu. Choose the stable option and update again to return to an official release.

windowsOfProcess.name: WindowsOfProcess
windowsOfProcess.author: 沉浮 <394434124@qq.com>
windowsOfProcess.description: allows you to quickly switch between windows with the same process or different process

wintenApps.name: Windows App Essentials
wintenApps.author: josephsl
wintenApps.description: Improving support for various apps and controls on Windows 11

wordCount.name: Count elements of the selected text
wordCount.author: Rui Fontes
wordCount.description: announces the number of words, characters and paragraphs of the selected text pressing Control+Shift+F12. It also can create a list of the words used, ordered by number of occcurrences or alphabetically, display the lines containing a word and finally move to a specific line, pressing Control+Shift+F11.

wordHeaderFooterReader.name: Word Header & Footer Accessibility Assistant
wordHeaderFooterReader.author: Nandan Kumar Singh
wordHeaderFooterReader.description: Word Header & Footer Accessibility Assistant is an NVDA add-on that improves access to Microsoft Word headers and footers for blind and visually impaired users. It provides commands to read and edit the current section's header and footer, including support for first-page and odd/even page variants where available.

wordLangSwitch.name: Word Language Switching
wordLangSwitch.author: Barbara Henn - MBZ Ilvesheim
wordLangSwitch.description: Automatic voice switching for marked language changes in Microsoft Word and Outlook. The add-on obtains the language marked in the document via the Word object model and feeds it into NVDA's automatic language switching, so multilingual documents are read with the matching voice (e.g. neural/natural voices via OneCore or SAPI 5) - just like on the web. Requires "Automatic language switching" to be enabled in NVDA's speech settings. Includes optional dialect stripping and language code mappings for synthesizers that only match specific language codes.

wordNav.name: WordNav
wordNav.author: Tony Malykh <anton.malykh@gmail.com>
wordNav.description: Improved navigate by word and word selection commands.

wordPredictor.name: Word Predictor
wordPredictor.author: Lanie
wordPredictor.description: Watches what you type and predicts the next word using n-gram analysis with Kneser-Ney smoothing. Predictions are announced through NVDA's speech engine and can be accepted with NVDA+Control+number keys (1 through 0). Learns from your writing over time. Includes partial-word prediction and terminal auto-detection and a custom app exclusion list and a settings panel.

xPand.name: xPand
xPand.author: Chai Chaimee
xPand.description: xPand is a lightweight text-expansion add-on for NVDA that lets you define short codes for longer phrases. It features instant code expansion across diverse text editors and web browsers, smart editable field detection, a local settings manager with quick search, and automatic configuration storage with seamless legacy migration. Hot Keys: CTRL+F3 Single Tap : Open xPand AutoCorrect Double Tap : Open xPand Settings

xyOCR.name: Xinyi OCR
xyOCR.author: huaiyinfeilong <huaiyinfeilong@163.com>
xyOCR.description: Aggregating various offline and online OCR services.

youtubeCaptionReader.name: YouTube Caption Reader
youtubeCaptionReader.author: Im Seongho
youtubeCaptionReader.description: Reads changing captions in YouTube videos. Uses the browser accessibility tree and adaptive streaming speech for NVDA users.

zoomEnhancements.name: Zoom Enhancements
zoomEnhancements.author: josephsl
zoomEnhancements.description: An add-on which aims to enhance the experience while using Zoom and NVDA
